hero.headlineLine1: From the walls to the floors –
hero.description: {{siteName}} handles drywall, flooring, tiling, parquet, plumbing, and electrical work across {{serviceArea}}. Clean work. On schedule. Fair pricing.

trustSignals.licensedDesc: Registered master craftsman business in Bavaria with comprehensive insurance on every project.
trustSignals.onTimeDesc: We plan realistically and stick to our timelines. Your schedule matters to us as much as it does to you.
trustSignals.qualityDesc: Every project backed by our workmanship warranty. A job isn't done until you're satisfied.
trustSignals.ratedDesc: Trusted by clients across Munich – our reputation is our greatest asset.

servicesSection.headline: Our Services
servicesSection.description: From drywall to electrical work, we cover the trades that matter for your home, with one dependable team.

drywall.title: Drywall
drywall.description: Framing, boarding, ceilings, and partition walls – precisely finished for a flawless transition into surface work.

flooring.title: Flooring
flooring.description: Laminate, vinyl, and designer floor installation with clean subfloors and precise transitions – for homes and commercial spaces.

tiling.title: Tiling
tiling.description: Floor and wall tiling for bathrooms, kitchens, and wellness areas – from waterproofing to grouting, all in one hand.

parquet.title: Parquet Flooring
parquet.description: Classic herringbone, plank, or solid parquet – expertly laid, sanded, and sealed.

plumbing.title: Plumbing
plumbing.description: Bathroom and kitchen connections, pipework, and fixtures – reliably installed and repaired to current standards.

electrical.title: Electrical Work
electrical.description: From sockets to fuse boxes – safe, code-compliant electrical work for new builds and renovations.

projects.headline: Recent Projects
projects.description: Every project is a chance to show our craft. Here's a sample of our recent work across Munich.
